```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(tidymodels)
library(pROC)
library(pdp)
library(gbm)
library(kernlab)
library(gridExtra)
library(knitr)
library(rpart.plot)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

# Load Dataset + Clean
```{r}
# Load the full dataset
load("../data/severity.RData")

# Set the random seed to the last 4 digits of YOUR UNI
set.seed(3978)

# Randomly sample 1,000 participants
my_dat <- dat[sample(nrow(dat), 1000), ]

# Convert categorical variables to factors
my_dat <- my_dat |>
  mutate(
    severity = factor(severity, levels = c(1, 0), labels = c("severe", "not_severe")),
    gender = factor(gender),
    race = factor(race),
    smoking = factor(smoking),
    hypertension = factor(hypertension),
    diabetes = factor(diabetes),
    vaccine = factor(vaccine)
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(-id)

# 80/20 train/test split
set.seed(3978)
data_split <- initial_split(my_dat, prop = 0.8)
training_data <- training(data_split)
testing_data <- testing(data_split)
```

# EDA
```{r}
# Summary statistics table by severity group
summary_table <- my_dat |>
  group_by(severity) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    age_mean_sd = paste0(round(mean(age), 1), " (", round(sd(age), 1), ")"),
    bmi_mean_sd = paste0(round(mean(bmi), 1), " (", round(sd(bmi), 1), ")"),
    sbp_mean_sd = paste0(round(mean(SBP), 1), " (", round(sd(SBP), 1), ")"),
    ldl_mean_sd = paste0(round(mean(LDL), 1), " (", round(sd(LDL), 1), ")"),
    dep_mean_sd = paste0(round(mean(depression), 1), " (", round(sd(depression), 1), ")"),
    pct_male = paste0(round(mean(gender == 1) * 100, 1), "%"),
    pct_vaccinated = paste0(round(mean(vaccine == 1) * 100, 1), "%"),
    pct_htn = paste0(round(mean(hypertension == 1) * 100, 1), "%"),
    pct_diabetes = paste0(round(mean(diabetes == 1) * 100, 1), "%")
  ) |>
  t() |>
  as.data.frame()

kable(summary_table, 
      col.names = c("Severe", "Not Severe"),
      caption = "Summary Statistics by severity group.")
```
```{r}
# Figure 1a: box plots for continuous predictors 
p1 <- training_data |>
  dplyr::select(severity, age, bmi, SBP, LDL, depression) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -severity, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = severity, y = value, fill = severity)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "", y = "") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Figure 1b: bar chart for categorical predictors  
p2 <- training_data |>
  dplyr::select(severity, gender, race, smoking, hypertension, diabetes, vaccine) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -severity, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = value, fill = severity)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(y = "Proportion", x = "") +
  theme_bw()

# Combine
grid.arrange(p1, p2, nrow = 2)
```

# Model Training
```{r}
# ctrl object: shared across all 4 models
ctrl <- trainControl(method = "cv",
                     number = 10,
                     summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
                     classProbs = TRUE)
```

### Model 1: Logistic Regression

```{r}
set.seed(3978)
model.glm <- train(severity ~ .,
                   data = training_data,
                   method = "glm",
                   metric = "ROC",
                   trControl = ctrl)

model.glm$results
```
### Model 2: Decision Tree

```{r}
set.seed(3978)
model.rpart <- train(severity ~ .,
                     data = training_data,
                     method = "rpart",
                     tuneGrid = data.frame(cp = exp(seq(-8, -3, len = 100))),
                     metric = "ROC",
                     trControl = ctrl)

# CV plot — ROC vs cp (log scale)
plot(model.rpart, xTrans = log)

# Plot the final pruned tree
rpart.plot(model.rpart$finalModel)

# Best cp value
model.rpart$bestTune
```
### Model 3: AdaBoost

```{r}
gbmA.grid <- expand.grid(n.trees = c(100, 200, 500, 1000, 2000),
                         interaction.depth = 1:4,
                         shrinkage = c(0.001, 0.003, 0.005),
                         n.minobsinnode = 10)

set.seed(3978)
model.gbmA <- train(severity ~ .,
                    data = training_data,
                    method = "gbm",
                    distribution = "adaboost",
                    tuneGrid = gbmA.grid,
                    metric = "ROC",
                    trControl = ctrl,
                    verbose = FALSE)

model.gbmA$bestTune
ggplot(model.gbmA, highlight = TRUE)
```

### Model 4: SVM-Radial

```{r, warning = FALSE}
svmr.grid <- expand.grid(C = exp(seq(1, 7, len = 30)),
                         sigma = exp(seq(-10, -2, len = 15)))

set.seed(3978)
model.svmr <- train(severity ~ .,
                    data = training_data,
                    method = "svmRadialSigma",
                    tuneGrid = svmr.grid,
                    metric = "ROC",
                    trControl = ctrl)

model.svmr$bestTune

myCol <- rainbow(25)
myPar <- list(superpose.symbol = list(col = myCol),
              superpose.line   = list(col = myCol))

plot(model.svmr, highlight = TRUE, par.settings = myPar)
```

# Model Comparison
```{r}
resamp <- resamples(list(GLM = model.glm,
                         RPART = model.rpart,
                         GBM = model.gbmA,
                         SVMR = model.svmr))

summary(resamp)

# Box plot of CV ROC across models 
bwplot(resamp, metric = "ROC")

# Table 2: CV performance summary
cv_summary <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Logistic Regression", "Decision Tree", "AdaBoost", "SVM-Radial"),
  Mean_AUC = c(0.861, 0.833, 0.868, 0.859),
  Median_AUC = c(0.867, 0.844, 0.861, 0.871),
  Mean_Sensitivity = c(0.676, 0.679, 0.660, 0.734),
  Mean_Specificity = c(0.885, 0.893, 0.915, 0.810)
)

kable(cv_summary,
      caption = "Cross-validated model performance across 10 folds.",
      col.names = c("Model", "Mean AUC", "Median AUC",
                    "Mean Sensitivity", "Mean Specificity"),
      digits = 3)
```

# Test set performance & ROC curves
```{r}
# Get predicted probabilities on test set for all 4 models
glm.pred <- predict(model.glm, newdata = testing_data, type = "prob")[, "severe"]
rpart.pred <- predict(model.rpart, newdata = testing_data, type = "prob")[, "severe"]
gbmA.pred <- predict(model.gbmA, newdata = testing_data, type = "prob")[, "severe"]
svmr.pred <- predict(model.svmr, newdata = testing_data, type = "prob")[, "severe"]

# Compute ROC curves
roc.glm <- roc(testing_data$severity, glm.pred, quiet = TRUE)
roc.rpart <- roc(testing_data$severity, rpart.pred, quiet = TRUE)
roc.gbmA <- roc(testing_data$severity, gbmA.pred, quiet = TRUE)
roc.svmr <- roc(testing_data$severity, svmr.pred, quiet = TRUE)

# Plot all ROC curves together
plot(roc.glm, legacy.axes = TRUE, col = 1)
plot(roc.rpart, add = TRUE, col = 2)
plot(roc.gbmA, add = TRUE, col = 3)
plot(roc.svmr, add = TRUE, col = 4)

# AUC values in legend
auc_vals <- c(roc.glm$auc[1], roc.rpart$auc[1], 
                roc.gbmA$auc[1], roc.svmr$auc[1])
modelNames <- c("Logistic", "Decision Tree", "AdaBoost", "SVM-Radial")
legend("bottomright",
       legend = paste0(modelNames, ": ", round(auc_vals, 3)),
       col = 1:4, lwd = 2)
```

# Variable Importance
```{r}
# Variable importance from best model (AdaBoost)
summary(model.gbmA$finalModel, 
        las = 2, 
        cBars = 14, 
        cex.names = 0.7)
```
### PDP for top 3 variables
```{r}
# PDP for vaccine 
pdp.vaccine <- model.gbmA |>
  pdp::partial(pred.var = "vaccine",
               grid.resolution = 100,
               prob = TRUE) |>
  autoplot(rug = TRUE, train = training_data) +
  ggtitle("Vaccine Status")

# PDP for SBP 
pdp.sbp <- model.gbmA |>
  pdp::partial(pred.var = "SBP",
               grid.resolution = 100,
               prob = TRUE) |>
  autoplot(rug = TRUE, train = training_data) +
  ggtitle("Systolic Blood Pressure")

# PDP for BMI 
pdp.bmi <- model.gbmA |>
  pdp::partial(pred.var = "bmi",
               grid.resolution = 100,
               prob = TRUE) |>
  autoplot(rug = TRUE, train = training_data) +
  ggtitle("BMI")

# Combine into one figure
gridExtra::grid.arrange(pdp.vaccine, pdp.sbp, pdp.bmi, nrow = 1)
```

```{r}
# Predicted risk scores from AdaBoost on test set
risk_scores <- data.frame(
  predicted_prob = gbmA.pred,
  true_severity = testing_data$severity
) |> 
  arrange(desc(predicted_prob))

# Top 10 highest risk patients
risk_scores |>
  head(10) |>
  kable(caption = "Top 10 patients with highest predicted risk of severe COVID-19 infection.",
        col.names = c("Predicted Probability", "True Severity"),
        digits = 3)

# Distribution of risk scores by true severity group
risk_scores |>
  group_by(true_severity) |>
  summarise(
    mean_risk = round(mean(predicted_prob), 3),
    median_risk = round(median(predicted_prob), 3),
    min_risk = round(min(predicted_prob), 3),
    max_risk = round(max(predicted_prob), 3)
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "Distribution of predicted risk scores by true severity group.",
        col.names = c("Severity Group", "Mean", "Median", "Min", "Max"))
```
